flawless: The sanctum's doors remain shut, and your sword never scratched my wings.
Vigilance is not weariness ignored. It is weariness never felt.
solid: Your blades found me. The sanctum will heal what you have harmed.
I bear a few new wounds for this holy place, and I bear them gladly.
close: The sanctum shook, and I nearly fell before its altar. You fight like a saint gone astray.
My halo is dim and my wings heavy. You came nearer than any intruder before you.
